articles.title: Uniswap pushes deeper into tokenized assets with permissioned trading pools
articles.snippet: The framework, developed with Superstate, Securitize and Dowgo, lets regulated funds and securities trade on Uniswap while enforcing compliance rules necessary for institutions.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum-linked protocols lose $35 million in multiple attacks hours apart
articles.snippet: The attacks hit Verus, B² Network and other cross-chain systems, showing how compromised keys, upgrade powers and validation checks can empty protocols without breaking the underlying cryptography.

articles.title: Arbitrum-based AFX Trade drained of $24 million after bridge keys compromised
articles.snippet: Security firms said the attacker used enough hot-validator signatures to approve a 24.15 million USDC withdrawal, while Arbitrum said its native bridge was not affected.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs CEO backs ‘not perfect’ CLARITY Act as vote expected soon
articles.snippet: Goldman chief David Solomon will support the crypto market structure bill now in Congress, even as financial companies and banks are hesitant over provisions on stablecoins.

articles.title: BTC treasury firm Empery Digital invests $20M in AI data center developer Cardinal Data Power
articles.snippet: The investment marks Empery’s latest push into AI infrastructure as the company shifts capital away from its Bitcoin treasury strategy.
